passages.provision_quote: A statement of whether the current version of the terms of service defines each of the following categories of content, and, if so, the definitions of those categories, including any subcategories: (A) Hate speech or racism. (B) Extremism or radicalization. (C) Disinformation or misinformation. (D) Harassment. (E) Foreign political interference.
passages.note: Requires platforms to report moderation definitions/enforcement stats for misinformation among several content categories, but sets no duty to remove or label false content, so it is on-question yet direction-only per the annex's transparency-mandate guidance.

rows.reasoning: AB 587 (Gabriel, chaptered 2022) is a terms-of-service and content-moderation reporting mandate on large platforms, covering misinformation as one of several disclosed categories; it imposes no legal duty to remove or label false content, so it shows only that Gabriel acted on platform accountability without matching any rung's operative mechanism.
needs_source: Gabriel's own words or an instrument specifically requiring platforms to remove or label false/misinformation content, to separate the rungs
